name: Gravitic
description: Unlocks [color=#9520E9]Tether Mode[/color]: left click hooks, right click reels (tap: all the way, hold: while held). Jump to let go and keep your speed. Move 10% faster.

badge.name: Graviton Core
badge.description: Unlocks [color=#9520E9]Tether Mode[/color]: left click hooks, right click reels (tap: all the way, hold: while held). Jump to let go at speed. Move 10% faster.

commons.name: Gravity Skate
commons.description: Running builds to twice sprint speed. Swings and flings carry into the run.

adept.name: Blink
adept.description: Double-tap right click while hooked to teleport to the hook.

adept.name: Gravity Shift
adept.description: Double-tap right click while hooked to make that surface your floor.

master.name: Skyhook
master.description: Tether shots that miss anchor in empty air.

master.name: Zipline
master.description: Link two surfaces with a rope you can ride.

grandmaster.name: Airwalk
grandmaster.description: Walk off a ledge onto a glass floor. Jump drops it; tap Sneak to step down, hold to fall.
